panels.scene: DANA at a home-office desk, a mug and a plain phone, phone at her ear, looking relaxed, the green kettle on a shelf behind her.
dialogue: Hi Dad. What are you building?

panels.scene: WALT at his garage workbench, a bicycle brake in his hands, phone propped on the bench, pleased and busy.
dialogue: A new brake. Listen to this.

panels.scene: DANA at a home-office desk, a mug and a plain phone, laughing quietly with the phone at her ear, leaning back in her chair.
panels.caption: The call got to be about the bike.
